QUOTE: Doxygen itself reads only files matching `FILE_PATTERNS`... The in-scope set is also passed on as `scanned_files`, which lets the JS/TS front end register files doxygen will not read (cli.py:1747). Also: `_drop_binary_files` non-text files removed (cli.py:1745, filetypes.py)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says scope isn't the whole story and names both the JS/TS front end registering files doxygen can't read and binary-file dropping after scope.
